## Description

The plan shows the prescription with an action per medicine: continue, new, change (new dose), taper (a stepped dose with an end date) or stop, using the reconciliation and the composer. Tests are toggles that create draft orders. Advice for the patient is written once and printed and sent in the patient's language when a reviewed translation exists, otherwise in English with a note. Follow-up is a choice (for example 2 weeks, 1 month, 3 months) that the front desk sees as a booking to make. Referral opens the existing referral letter.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Change and taper are recorded on the reconciliation with the old and new dose and print on the prescription.
- [ ] **AC2.** A test toggled on creates a draft order once; toggling off removes the draft, not an ordered one.
- [ ] **AC3.** The follow-up choice appears on the front desk's list for that patient.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
